messages:
Maya: FYI - noticed ~30% GPU warmup join failures in us-west-2 starting 02:33 UTC. Pattern: ephemeral-keystore calls timing out, then nodes hit 'penaltybox' circuitbreaker.
Ravi: Which change touched the circuitbreaker?
Maya: Keystore proxy rollout at 02:30 UTC introduced an egress circuitbreaker (threshold 120 qps/az). Audit-shipper backfill spiked and we tripped it.
Nina: Any 5xx from keystore or just timeouts?
Maya: Timeouts. Example: 
```
2026-03-23T02:34:12Z keystore-proxy timeout for gpu-node-77: dial tcp 10.0.8.77:443: i/o timeout
2026-03-23T02:34:13Z circuitbreaker: penaltybox enter keystore-usw2-azc
```
Carlos: Penaltybox blocks ephemeral key fetch -> disk decrypt failures -> join evictions for warmup tier. We should avoid evicting warmup hosts for keystore timeouts.
Ravi: Quick mitigations: 1) increase egress quota for audit-shipper in region 2) relax breaker to 200 qps 3) flip audit-shipper to direct-s3 mode. Cost impact?
Carlos: Ballpark: raising quota +50% for 2h ~= $2.2k. Whitelist only audit-shipper ~ $850.
Nina: There's a flag --audit-direct-s3 on the shipper. We can canary it.
Maya: I can roll canary now (need approval).
Ravi: Approved. Canary 10% -> watch keystore QPS and join rate.
Ops-bot: deploy requested by Maya at 02:51 UTC (canary 10%)
Maya: Canary results: audit keystore calls down ~88% on canary hosts, warmup joins recovered to baseline, penaltybox not tripping for those hosts.
Carlos: Great. Action items: 1) Add metric egress.circuitbreaker.penaltybox.count 2) Change warmup join behavior to treat keystore timeouts as degraded, not evict 3) Rework audit-shipper backpressure/batching.
Ravi: I'll log ticket ENGINFRA-8042 for the warmup behavior change. Maya, open PR for audit-direct-s3 and longer-term keystore retry/backoff.
Maya: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/keystore-proxy/pull/534 - tests passing.
Carlos: We'll charge incident ops budget if we ever do emergency egress bump. Keep cost cap $3k.
Nina: I'll update runbook section "egress circuitbreaker: penaltybox" with rollback and canary steps.
Maya: Marking resolved once PR merges and metrics stable for 24h. Thanks all :thumbsup:
